fp32.z_add.rule: A = -0 at k>=1, B[k][j] = sgn j; k=0 (2^50, -2^50 sgn j): C agrees with each zero product: always adds

fp32.z_sub.rule: z_add's operands at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, 2^50): C all +: alternates every micro-op on a zero product

fp32.u_sub.rule: k=0 (2^50, 2^50), B[k][j] = sgn(j) (-1)^(k+1) at k=1..14, +1 at k=15: C all +, eff_sub alternates on 14/15 of h_sub's micro-ops, each half subtracting on 7

fp32.z_s.rule: E92's fp32.s_abs with A = -0 at k>=1: B's random +-1 sets eff_sub, about half the micro-ops alternate, C holds the k = 0 sums

fp32.m_h_sub.rule: k=0 (4, 4 / 7.75 by half), B[k][j] = sgn j: C[l] = +31 n, C[l+8] = +16 n: alternates, w_h_add's magnitudes

fp16.z_add.rule: A words (-0, -0) at k-group>=1, B words (1, 1) / (-1, -1) by half; k-group-0 (2^15, -+2^15 by half): C agrees with each zero product: always adds

fp16.z_sub.rule: z_add's operands at k-group>=1; k-group-0 (2^15, 2^15): C all +: both eff_sub alternate on zero products

fp16.z_allsub.rule: z_add's operands at k-group>=1; C[l] +, C[l+8] -: always subtracts on zero products

fp16.z_hh.rule: A words (-0, -0), B words (lo, hi) (-1, -1) / (-1, 1) by half, C all +: only the high product's eff_sub1 alternates (aligner 1)

fp16.z_hl.rule: A words (-0, -0), B words (lo, hi) (-1, -1) / (1, -1) by half, C all +: only the low product's eff_sub2 alternates (aligner 2)

fp16.u_sub.rule: words (1, 1), k-group-0 (2^15, 2^15), B words sgn(j) (-1)^(k+1) (1, 1) at k-group 1..14, (1, 1) at k-group 15: C all +, both eff_sub alternate on 14/15 of h_sub's micro-ops, each half subtracting on 7: the halves lose the same ulps and meet each op

fp16.z_s.rule: E92's fp16.s_abs with A words (-0, -0) at k-group>=1: B's random +-1 sets each eff_sub, C holds the k-group-0 sums

fp16.x_add.rule: A words (1, 1), B words (lo, hi) (1, -1) / (-1, 1) by half: each micro-op's products cancel; k-group-0 (2, 2) x (4, 4) / (-4, -4): C = +16 n, -16 n, eff_sub fixed

fp16.x_sub.rule: x_add's operands at k-group>=1; k-group-0 (2, 2) x (4, 4): C = +16 n: eff_sub1 and eff_sub2 alternate in opposite phase, C holds

fp16.w_c.rule: k-group-0 (2, 2) x (8, 8) / (0.5, 0.5) by half, all + at k-group>=1: C[l] = +62 n, C[l+8] = +32 n: always adds

fp16.w_h_sub.rule: k-group-0 (2, 2) x (8, 8), B words (1, 1) / (-1, -1): C[l] = +62 n, C[l+8] = +2 n: alternates (fp32's w_h_sub, on fp16)

fp16.m_h_sub.rule: k-group-0 (2, 2) x (8, 8) / (15.5, 15.5), B words (1, 1) / (-1, -1): C[l] = +62 n, C[l+8] = +32 n: alternates, w_h_add's magnitudes
